_provenance.strategies: This repository's own vocabulary, app layer.
_provenance.typesafe_criteria: English criteria sent to the TypeSafe Jev service.
_provenance.deepseek_criteria: Chinese definitions sent to the DeepSeek route. The fuller Windows wording was chosen over Android's shorter one on 2026-10-02; it keeps the constraining clauses ('不取笑脆弱处', '有可信的时间或活动契机').

typesafe_criteria.承接: Acknowledge the other person's feelings or what they shared; listen without rushing to solve or escalate.
typesafe_criteria.降压: Reduce pressure when they are busy, tired, hesitant, or have received repeated questions. Pause pursuit without treating one ambiguous reply as rejection.
typesafe_criteria.调侃: Light, respectful playful banter when the other person clearly reciprocates jokes; never mock vulnerability or ignore discomfort.
typesafe_criteria.轻推: Move a mutually engaged but stalled conversation one small step forward, without asking for commitment.
typesafe_criteria.约见: Offer a concrete, low-pressure meeting when there is reciprocal interest and a credible time/activity opening.
typesafe_criteria.澄清: Ask about one key unknown or contradiction that prevents a responsible next step. Do not interrogate or speculate about hidden intentions.
typesafe_criteria.收线: Stop pursuing after an explicit refusal or boundary, or repeated one-sided investment/cancellations. A single busy reply alone does not establish this pattern.

deepseek_criteria.承接: 接住对方说的事或感受，不急着推进
deepseek_criteria.降压: 对方忙、累、迟疑或被连续追问时降低压力
deepseek_criteria.调侃: 对方也在开玩笑时轻松接话，不取笑脆弱处
deepseek_criteria.轻推: 双方投入但停滞时推进一个小步骤
deepseek_criteria.约见: 双方有兴趣且有可信的时间或活动契机时低压邀约
deepseek_criteria.澄清: 关键事实未知时只问一个必要问题
deepseek_criteria.收线: 明确拒绝、边界或长期单向投入时停止推进
